description.value: Yuki Cafe is a neighbourhood sushi restaurant on Kingsway in East Vancouver, run by Japanese Master Chef Yuki who brings over 20 years of culinary expertise to the menu. The cafe positions itself around fresh ingredients, high quality, and good value — a combination that makes it a practical stop on one of Vancouver's main east-west cycling corridors. Indoor seating is available, and online ordering is supported for those who prefer takeout.
